verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork page claims AI agents collect, validate, and package evidence across enterprise systems on the customer's schedule. Integration docs show automated monitoring of AWS, GitHub, and Google Workspace resources. However, this is a thin marketing claim, and no documentation shows how the collected artifacts are timestamped, stored, or presented to auditors in place of screenshots and CSV exports. missing for 10: documented scheduling configuration for evidence collection, timestamped artifact format and audit trail, explicit mapping of integration data to control evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, evidence is collected automatically from connected systems on a schedule — screenshots and CSV exports are replaced by timestamped, machine-gathered artifacts

citations.quote: Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.
Oneleet currently monitors the following AWS resources: Accounts, RDS instances, Application and Classic load balancers, IAM users
You can use it to monitor your GitHub configuration, user access, and Dependabot vulnerabilities.
